items.stem: What is the value of (2/3 + 0.75) ÷ 1 1/6?
items.why: Fastest: turn everything into twelfths and sixths. 0.75 = 3/4, so 2/3 + 3/4 = 8/12 + 9/12 = 17/12. 1 1/6 = 7/6, and dividing by 7/6 is multiplying by 6/7: 17/12 x 6/7 = 17/14 (the 6 cancels into the 12). Full method: Step 1, convert the decimal and the mixed number: 0.75 = 3/4 and 1 1/6 = 7/6. Step 2, add inside the parentheses over 12: 17/12. Step 3, divide by flipping and multiplying: 17/12 x 6/7 = 102/84 = 17/14. Takeaway: parentheses first, mixed numbers become improper fractions, and dividing means multiplying by the reciprocal.

items.stem: If 3(2x - 5) = 4x + 7, what is the value of x?
items.why: Fastest: distribute, collect, divide. 6x - 15 = 4x + 7, so 2x = 22 and x = 11. Check: 3(22 - 5) = 51 and 4(11) + 7 = 51. Full method: Step 1, distribute the 3 to both terms: 6x - 15. Step 2, subtract 4x from both sides: 2x - 15 = 7. Step 3, add 15: 2x = 22. Step 4, divide by 2: x = 11. Takeaway: the number outside the parentheses hits every term inside, and a term that crosses the equals sign changes sign.

items.stem: A map uses a scale of 1.5 cm to 12 km. Two towns are 7.5 cm apart on the map. How far apart are they in kilometers?
items.why: Fastest: count scale units. 7.5 / 1.5 = 5 units, and 5 x 12 km = 60 km. Full method: set up the proportion 1.5 cm / 12 km = 7.5 cm / d km. Cross-multiply: 1.5d = 90, so d = 60 km. Takeaway: a map scale is a ratio; keep centimeters with centimeters and kilometers with kilometers.

items.stem: A price rises by 20 percent and then falls by 20 percent. The final price is what percent of the original?
items.why: Fastest: pretend the price is 100. Up 20 percent gives 120; down 20 percent of 120 is 24, leaving 96, so 96 percent. Full method: successive percent changes multiply as growth factors: 1.20 x 0.80 = 0.96, which is 96 percent of the original. Takeaway: successive percents multiply; equal ups and downs always end below where you started.

items.stem: What is the value of 8^(2/3) × 4^(-1/2)?
items.why: Fastest: root first, then power. Cube root of 8 is 2, squared is 4. Square root of 4 is 2, and the minus sign makes it 1/2. 4 x 1/2 = 2. Full method: write both in base 2. 8^(2/3) = (2^3)^(2/3) = 2^2. 4^(-1/2) = (2^2)^(-1/2) = 2^(-1). Multiply by adding exponents: 2^(2 - 1) = 2. Takeaway: in a^(m/n), the n is the root and the m is the power; a negative exponent flips to a reciprocal.

items.stem: A cone is carved out of a cylinder with the same radius, 3, and the same height, 8. What volume of the cylinder remains?
items.why: Fastest: a cone is one third of its matching cylinder, so two thirds remains. Cylinder = pi(9)(8) = 72 pi; two thirds of 72 pi = 48 pi. Full method: Step 1, cylinder volume pi r^2 h = pi(3^2)(8) = 72 pi. Step 2, cone volume (1/3) pi r^2 h = 24 pi. Step 3, subtract: 72 pi - 24 pi = 48 pi. Takeaway: same base and same height means cone = 1/3 of the cylinder.

items.stem: Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that their sum is 8?
items.why: Fastest: the dice hill. Sums of 7 have 6 ways, and each step away from 7 loses one way, so 8 has 5 ways out of 36. Full method: list the ordered pairs that sum to 8: (2,6), (3,5), (4,4), (5,3), (6,2). That is 5 of the 6 x 6 = 36 outcomes, so 5/36. Takeaway: with two dice, count ordered pairs; 6 goes with 7, and each sum farther from 7 has one fewer way.

items.stem: The mean of five numbers is 12. When a sixth number is added, the mean becomes 13. What is the sixth number?
items.why: Fastest: totals. Old total = 5 x 12 = 60; new total = 6 x 13 = 78; the new number is 78 - 60 = 18. Full method: mean x count = sum. Before: 60. After: 78. The difference is the added value, 18. Check: (60 + 18) / 6 = 13. Takeaway: when a value is added or removed, switch from means to totals.

items.stem: Pipe A fills a tank in 6 hours and pipe B fills it in 3 hours. How long do they take to fill it together?
items.why: Fastest: product over sum for two workers: (6 x 3) / (6 + 3) = 18/9 = 2 hours. Full method: rates add. Pipe A fills 1/6 of the tank per hour and pipe B 1/3 = 2/6. Together: 3/6 = 1/2 tank per hour, so 2 hours. Takeaway: together means add the rates, never the times; the answer is faster than the faster worker.

items.stem: A dental assistant needs 3/8 liter of rinse solution and has already measured 0.25 liter. How many more liters are needed?
items.why: Fastest: know your eighths. 1/8 = 0.125, so 3/8 = 0.375, and 0.375 - 0.25 = 0.125. Full method: Step 1, convert 3/8 by dividing 3 by 8: 0.375. Step 2, subtract what is already there: 0.375 - 0.250 = 0.125 liter. (In fractions: 3/8 - 2/8 = 1/8.) Takeaway: memorize the eighths (0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5, ...) and keep exact decimals until the last step.

items.stem: A seedling is 5 cm tall and grows 3 cm each week. After how many weeks will it be 20 cm tall?
items.why: Fastest: growth needed over growth rate. It must grow 20 - 5 = 15 cm at 3 cm per week: 15 / 3 = 5 weeks. Full method: height = 5 + 3w. Set 5 + 3w = 20. Subtract 5: 3w = 15. Divide by 3: w = 5. Check: 5 + 3(5) = 20. Takeaway: start plus rate times time; subtract the start before you divide by the rate.

items.stem: In a stained tissue sample, 2 of every 5 cells take up the dye. At that rate, how many of 20 cells in a field of view are expected to take up the dye?
items.why: Fastest: scale the ratio. 5 cells becomes 20 cells by multiplying by 4, so 2 dyed cells becomes 8. Full method: dyed / total stays the same: 2/5 = x/20. Cross-multiply: 5x = 40, so x = 8. Takeaway: write the proportion with matching labels on top and bottom, then scale.

items.stem: Of 150 patients screened at a clinic, 20 percent needed a follow-up visit. How many patients needed a follow-up visit?
items.why: Fastest: 10 percent of 150 is 15, so 20 percent is 30. Full method: percent of a number is the decimal times the number: 0.20 x 150 = 30 patients. Takeaway: find 10 percent by moving the decimal one place, then scale; 'percent of' always means multiply.

items.stem: A culture starts with 3 cells, and the number of cells doubles every hour. How many cells are there after 5 hours?
items.why: Fastest: count the doublings on your fingers. 3, 6, 12, 24, 48, 96: five doublings after the start. Full method: start x factor^periods = 3 x 2^5 = 3 x 32 = 96 cells. Takeaway: n doublings multiply by 2^n, never by 2n, and the start is not a doubling.

items.stem: A rectangular lab bench top is 8 feet long and 30 inches wide. What is its area, in square feet?
items.why: Fastest: convert first. 30 inches = 30/12 = 2.5 feet, and 8 x 2.5 = 20 square feet. Full method: Step 1, match units: 30 in / 12 in per ft = 2.5 ft. Step 2, area = 8 ft x 2.5 ft = 20 square feet. (Check: 2,880 square inches / 144 square inches per square foot = 20.) Takeaway: put every length in the same unit before multiplying; a square foot is 144 square inches.

items.stem: A bag contains 3 red marbles and 5 blue marbles. If one marble is drawn at random, what is the probability that it is red?
items.why: Fastest: favorable over total: 3 red out of 8 marbles = 3/8. Full method: one draw, all marbles equally likely. P(red) = (number of red) / (total) = 3 / (3 + 5) = 3/8. Takeaway: probability is part over whole, so the denominator is everything in the bag.

items.stem: What is the mean of the data set 3, 5, 8, 12, 2?
items.why: Fastest: add and divide: 3 + 5 + 8 + 12 + 2 = 30, and 30 / 5 = 6. Full method: mean = sum / count = 30 / 5 = 6. (For contrast: sorted 2, 3, 5, 8, 12 gives median 5, and the range is 10.) Takeaway: mean is sum over count; median needs sorting first; range is largest minus smallest.

items.stem: A car travels 180 miles in 3 hours. What is its average speed?
items.why: Fastest: miles per hour means miles divided by hours: 180 / 3 = 60. Full method: average speed = total distance / total time = 180 miles / 3 hours = 60 miles per hour. Takeaway: let the units decide: 'per' means divide.

items.stem: What is the value of 3/4 − 0.6 + 1/5?
items.why: Fastest: go to decimals: 0.75 - 0.60 + 0.20 = 0.35. Full method: Step 1, convert: 3/4 = 0.75 and 1/5 = 0.20. Step 2, work left to right: 0.75 - 0.60 = 0.15, then 0.15 + 0.20 = 0.35. Takeaway: convert to one form, then keep each sign attached to the term after it.

items.stem: If 3(x − 2) = 2x + 5, what is the value of x?
items.why: Fastest: distribute, then move everything once: 3x - 6 = 2x + 5, so x = 11. Check: 3(9) = 27 and 2(11) + 5 = 27. Full method: Step 1, 3(x - 2) = 3x - 6. Step 2, subtract 2x from both sides: x - 6 = 5. Step 3, add 6: x = 11. Takeaway: distribute to every term, then check your answer in the original equation.

items.stem: In a class the ratio of boys to girls is 5:3. If there are 32 students total, how many are girls?
items.why: Fastest: parts. 5 + 3 = 8 parts in 32 students, so 1 part = 4 and girls = 3 parts = 12. Full method: girls are 3 of every 8 students: 3/8 x 32 = 12. Check: boys 20, and 20 : 12 = 5 : 3. Takeaway: add the ratio parts to get the whole, find one part, then scale.

items.stem: After a 25 percent discount, a jacket sells for 90 dollars. What was its original price, in dollars?
items.why: Fastest: 90 is 75 percent of the original, so 90 is 3 quarters; one quarter is 30 and four quarters are 120. Full method: original x 0.75 = 90, so original = 90 / 0.75 = 120 dollars. Check: 25 percent of 120 is 30, and 120 - 30 = 90. Takeaway: to undo a percent change, divide by the growth factor; never add the percent back on to the new value.

items.stem: Which of the following is equivalent to (2^3 × 2^−1)^2?
items.why: Fastest: exponents only. Inside: 3 + (-1) = 2. Outside: 2 x 2 = 4. 2^4 = 16. Full method: Step 1, multiplying powers adds exponents: 2^3 x 2^-1 = 2^2. Step 2, a power of a power multiplies: (2^2)^2 = 2^4. Step 3, 2^4 = 16. Takeaway: multiply powers add exponents, power of a power multiplies them, and the sign of an exponent comes along.

items.stem: A cylinder has radius 3 and height 10. What is its volume?
items.why: Fastest: base area times height. Base = pi(3^2) = 9 pi; times 10 = 90 pi. Full method: V = pi r^2 h = pi(9)(10) = 90 pi cubic units. Takeaway: a cylinder is a stack of circles: pi r^2 for the base, times the height.

items.stem: A bag holds 4 red and 6 blue marbles. Two marbles are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
items.why: Fastest: (4/10)(3/9) = (2/5)(1/3) = 2/15. Full method: P(first red) = 4/10. Without replacement, 3 reds remain of 9 marbles, so P(second red | first red) = 3/9. Multiply: 12/90 = 2/15. Takeaway: without replacement, the top and the bottom both drop by one on the second draw.

items.stem: Find the median of the data set: 8, 15, 4, 8, 10
items.why: Fastest: sort and take the middle: 4, 8, 8, 10, 15, so the median is 8. Full method: with 5 values the median is the 3rd in sorted order: 8. (The mean is 9 and the range is 11, a different question each.) Takeaway: median means sort first; with an odd count it is the single middle value.

items.stem: One pipe fills a tank in 4 hours and another fills it in 6 hours. Working together, how long does it take to fill the tank?
items.why: Fastest: product over sum: (4 x 6) / (4 + 6) = 24/10 = 2.4 hours. Full method: rates add: 1/4 + 1/6 = 3/12 + 2/12 = 5/12 tank per hour. Time = 1 / (5/12) = 12/5 = 2.4 hours. Takeaway: add rates, then flip to get the time; the answer must be under the faster worker's time.

Fastest: everything in twelfths: 8/12 - 3/12 + 2/12 = 7/12. Full method: the least common denominator of 3, 4 and 6 is 12. 2/3 = 8/12, 1/4 = 3/12, 1/6 = 2/12. Then 8 - 3 + 2 = 7, so 7/12. Takeaway: common denominator first, then add or subtract the numerators with their signs.

items.stem: If 2(3x - 4) = 4x + 6, what is the value of x?
items.why: Fastest: 6x - 8 = 4x + 6, so 2x = 14 and x = 7. Check: 2(21 - 4) = 34 and 4(7) + 6 = 34. Full method: Step 1, distribute: 6x - 8. Step 2, subtract 4x: 2x - 8 = 6. Step 3, add 8: 2x = 14. Step 4, divide: x = 7. Takeaway: distribute to every term, collect x on one side, constants on the other, then divide.

items.stem: At a shelter the ratio of cats to dogs is 3:5. If there are 24 animals in all, how many are dogs?
items.why: Fastest: 8 parts in 24 animals, so 3 per part, and dogs are 5 parts: 15. Full method: dogs are 5 of every 3 + 5 = 8 animals: 5/8 x 24 = 15. Check: cats 9, and 9 : 15 = 3 : 5. Takeaway: part over the sum of the parts gives the fraction of the whole.

items.stem: A shirt priced at 80 dollars is marked 25 percent off, and then an extra 10 percent is taken off the discounted price at checkout. What is the final price, in dollars?
items.why: Fastest: multiply the factors: 80 x 0.75 = 60, then 60 x 0.9 = 54. Full method: Step 1, 25 percent off leaves 75 percent: 80 x 0.75 = 60. Step 2, 10 percent off the new price leaves 90 percent: 60 x 0.90 = 54 dollars. Takeaway: successive discounts multiply; 25 off then 10 off is a 46 percent total cut, not 35.

items.stem: Simplify (2x^3)^2 * x^4.
items.why: Fastest: coefficient and exponent separately. 2^2 = 4; 3 x 2 = 6, then 6 + 4 = 10. So 4x^10. Full method: Step 1, power of a product: (2x^3)^2 = 2^2 (x^3)^2 = 4x^6. Step 2, multiply by x^4: 4x^(6 + 4) = 4x^10. Takeaway: a power applies to the coefficient too; power of a power multiplies exponents; multiplying powers adds them.

items.stem: A circle has a diameter of 10 cm. What is its area? (Use pi = 3.14.)
items.why: Fastest: halve, square, times pi: r = 5, r^2 = 25, 3.14 x 25 = 78.5. Full method: r = d/2 = 5 cm. A = pi r^2 = 3.14 x 25 = 78.5 square cm. Takeaway: check whether you were given r or d before you use pi r^2.

items.stem: A box holds 6 good fuses and 3 defective fuses. Two fuses are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both are good?
items.why: Fastest: (6/9)(5/8) = (2/3)(5/8) = 10/24 = 5/12. Full method: P(first good) = 6/9. Without replacement, 5 good fuses remain among 8, so P(second good) = 5/8. Multiply: 30/72 = 5/12. (Combinations agree: C(6,2)/C(9,2) = 15/36 = 5/12.) Takeaway: without replacement, both the favorable count and the total drop by one on the second draw.

items.stem: Find the median of the data set: 16, 4, 42, 15, 8, 23.
items.why: Fastest: sort, then average the middle pair: 4, 8, 15, 16, 23, 42 gives (15 + 16)/2 = 15.5. Full method: an even count (6) has two middle values, the 3rd and 4th in sorted order. Their average is the median: 15.5. Takeaway: sort first; with an even count, the median is the mean of the two middle values.

items.stem: Machine A can label a batch of vials in 5 hours, and machine B can label the same batch in 20 hours. Working together, how many hours do the two machines take to label the batch?
items.why: Fastest: product over sum: (5 x 20) / (5 + 20) = 100/25 = 4 hours. Full method: A labels 1/5 of the batch per hour and B 1/20. Together: 4/20 + 1/20 = 5/20 = 1/4 per hour, so the batch takes 4 hours. Takeaway: together means add rates; the combined time is always shorter than the faster machine alone.

items.stem: Evaluate the expression (5/8 + 0.25) divided by (3/4).
items.why: Fastest: work in eighths. 0.25 = 2/8, so 5/8 + 2/8 = 7/8. Then 7/8 x 4/3 = 28/24 = 7/6. Full method: Step 1, convert 0.25 = 1/4 = 2/8. Step 2, add: 7/8. Step 3, divide by 3/4 by multiplying by 4/3: 7/8 x 4/3 = 7/6. Takeaway: convert decimals to fractions that share a denominator, and divide by flipping the divisor.

items.stem: The numbers x and y satisfy 3x + 2y = 18 and x - y = 1. What is the value of the product xy?
items.why: Fastest: x = y + 1. Substitute: 3(y + 1) + 2y = 18, so 5y = 15, y = 3 and x = 4. xy = 12. Full method: Step 1, from x - y = 1, x = y + 1. Step 2, 3y + 3 + 2y = 18 gives 5y + 3 = 18, y = 3. Step 3, x = 4. Step 4, xy = 12. Check: 3(4) + 2(3) = 18. Takeaway: solve the system completely, then answer exactly what is asked (here a product).

items.stem: A dough recipe uses flour to sugar in the ratio 5:3. A baker mixes a batch containing 20 cups of flour, then stirs in 4 extra cups of sugar. What is the new ratio of flour to sugar in simplest form?
items.why: Fastest: 20 cups of flour is 5 parts of 4 cups, so the sugar is 3 x 4 = 12 cups. Add 4: 16. Flour to sugar = 20 : 16 = 5 : 4. Full method: Step 1, scale factor 20 / 5 = 4, so sugar = 12 cups. Step 2, new sugar = 16 cups. Step 3, 20 : 16, divide both by 4: 5 : 4. Takeaway: turn ratio parts into real amounts before you add anything, then simplify.

items.stem: A jacket is priced at 80 dollars. A store takes 25 percent off, then adds a 10 percent sales tax to the discounted price. What is the final price, in dollars?
items.why: Fastest: 80 x 0.75 = 60, then 60 x 1.1 = 66. Full method: Step 1, 25 percent off leaves 75 percent: 60 dollars. Step 2, 10 percent tax on 60 is 6, so 66 dollars. Takeaway: apply percent changes in order as factors (0.75 then 1.10); never net them by adding.

items.stem: Evaluate the square root of 50, divided by the square root of 2, then add 2 cubed.
items.why: Fastest: sqrt(50)/sqrt(2) = sqrt(25) = 5, and 2^3 = 8, so 13. Full method: Step 1, a quotient of roots is the root of the quotient: sqrt(50/2) = sqrt(25) = 5. Step 2, 2^3 = 8. Step 3, 5 + 8 = 13. Takeaway: roots split and join over multiplication and division, never over addition.

items.stem: A cube has a total surface area of 96 square centimeters. What is its volume?
items.why: Fastest: one face is 96 / 6 = 16, so the side is 4 and the volume is 4^3 = 64. Full method: Step 1, a cube has 6 equal square faces: 6s^2 = 96, so s^2 = 16. Step 2, s = 4 cm. Step 3, V = s^3 = 64 cubic cm. Takeaway: surface area / 6 gives one face; its square root is the edge.

items.stem: A bag contains 4 red, 3 blue, and 5 green marbles. Two marbles are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both are green?
items.why: Fastest: (5/12)(4/11) = 20/132 = 5/33. Full method: 12 marbles, 5 green. P(first green) = 5/12; then 4 green of 11 remain: 4/11. Multiply: 5/33. (Combinations agree: C(5,2)/C(12,2) = 10/66 = 5/33.) Takeaway: AND multiplies, and without replacement the top and bottom each drop by one.

items.stem: For the data set 4, 8, 8, 12, 18, what is the mean minus the median?
items.why: Fastest: mean = 50/5 = 10, median = the 3rd value = 8, difference = 2. Full method: Step 1, sum = 4 + 8 + 8 + 12 + 18 = 50, so mean = 10. Step 2, the list is already sorted, so median = 8. Step 3, 10 - 8 = 2. Takeaway: one large value drags the mean above the median (right skew); subtract in the order asked.

items.stem: How many liters of a 20% acid solution must be added to 10 liters of a 50% acid solution to produce a mixture that is 30% acid?
items.why: Fastest: seesaw. 30 is 10 from 20 and 20 from 50, so the amounts are 2 : 1 with the larger share at 20 percent: 2 x 10 L = 20 L. Full method: acid in = acid out: 0.20x + 0.50(10) = 0.30(x + 10). So 0.20x + 5 = 0.30x + 3, giving 0.10x = 2 and x = 20 liters. Takeaway: track the pure substance, and remember the total volume grows by what you add.

items.stem: What is the value of 0.4 + (3/5)(2/3)?
items.why: Fastest: (3/5)(2/3) = 2/5 = 0.4 (the 3s cancel), then 0.4 + 0.4 = 0.8. Full method: order of operations puts the multiplication first: (3/5)(2/3) = 6/15 = 2/5 = 0.4. Then add: 0.4 + 0.4 = 0.8. Takeaway: multiply before you add, and cancel before you multiply.

items.stem: If 3(2x - 4) = 2(x + 6) - 4, what is the value of x?
items.why: Fastest: 6x - 12 = 2x + 8, so 4x = 20 and x = 5. Check: 3(6) = 18 and 2(11) - 4 = 18. Full method: Step 1, left: 6x - 12. Step 2, right: 2x + 12 - 4 = 2x + 8. Step 3, subtract 2x and add 12: 4x = 20. Step 4, x = 5. Takeaway: simplify each side completely before moving terms across.

items.stem: A map is drawn at a scale of 1 cm : 6 km. Two towns are 6 cm apart on the map. A car drives between them at 72 km/h. How many minutes does the drive take?
items.why: Fastest: 36 km at 72 km per hour is half an hour, 30 minutes. Full method: Step 1, real distance = 6 cm x 6 km per cm = 36 km. Step 2, time = 36 / 72 = 0.5 hour. Step 3, 0.5 x 60 = 30 minutes. Takeaway: convert the map distance first, and finish in the unit the question asks for.

items.stem: After a 20 percent increase, a clinic sees 360 patients per week. How many patients per week did it see before the increase?
items.why: Fastest: 360 is 120 percent of the original, so 1 percent is 3 and 100 percent is 300. Full method: original x 1.20 = 360, so original = 360 / 1.2 = 300. Check: 20 percent of 300 is 60, and 300 + 60 = 360. Takeaway: to undo a percent increase, divide by the growth factor; 'percent of' always uses the starting value as the base.

items.stem: Which of the following is equivalent to sqrt(50) + sqrt(18) - sqrt(8)?
items.why: Fastest: pull out perfect squares: 5 sqrt(2) + 3 sqrt(2) - 2 sqrt(2) = 6 sqrt(2). Full method: sqrt(50) = sqrt(25 x 2) = 5 sqrt(2); sqrt(18) = sqrt(9 x 2) = 3 sqrt(2); sqrt(8) = sqrt(4 x 2) = 2 sqrt(2). Like radicals combine like like terms: (5 + 3 - 2) sqrt(2) = 6 sqrt(2). Takeaway: simplify every radical to the same root, then add the coefficients.

items.stem: A cylindrical can has a diameter of 10 cm and a height of 12 cm. About how many liters does it hold? (Use pi = 3.14. 1 liter = 1,000 cubic cm.)
items.why: Fastest: 3.14 x 25 x 12 = 3.14 x 300 = 942 cubic cm, which is 0.942 liter. Full method: Step 1, r = 10/2 = 5 cm. Step 2, V = pi r^2 h = 3.14 x 25 x 12 = 942 cubic cm. Step 3, 942 / 1,000 = 0.942 liter. Takeaway: halve the diameter, square the radius, then let the unit conversion be the last step.

items.stem: A study group has 7 dental students and 3 hygiene students. Two members are chosen at random to present. What is the probability that one dental student and one hygiene student are chosen?
items.why: Fastest: groups. Choose 1 of 7 and 1 of 3 out of all pairs: (7 x 3) / C(10,2) = 21/45 = 7/15. Full method: by order, P(dental then hygiene) = (7/10)(3/9) = 21/90 and P(hygiene then dental) = (3/10)(7/9) = 21/90. Add: 42/90 = 7/15. Takeaway: 'one of each' happens in two orders; count both, or count unordered groups.

items.stem: Find the median of the data set: 4, 8, 8, 10, 15, 21
items.why: Fastest: the list is sorted; the middle pair is 8 and 10, so the median is 9. Full method: six values give two middle positions, the 3rd and 4th: 8 and 10. Median = (8 + 10)/2 = 9. Takeaway: even count, average the middle pair; do not confuse median with mean, mode or range.

items.stem: How many liters of water must be added to 12 liters of a 30 percent alcohol solution to dilute it to 20 percent alcohol?
items.why: Fastest: the alcohol never changes. 3.6 L must be 20 percent of the new total, so the total is 3.6 / 0.2 = 18 L, and the water added is 18 - 12 = 6 L. Full method: 0.30(12) = 0.20(12 + w). So 3.6 = 2.4 + 0.2w, giving 0.2w = 1.2 and w = 6 liters. Takeaway: in a dilution, the pure substance stays fixed; only the total grows.

items.stem: Evaluate (3/4 − 0.2) × 2.5 and express the result as a fraction.
items.why: Fastest: 0.75 - 0.2 = 0.55 = 11/20, and 2.5 = 5/2, so 11/20 x 5/2 = 55/40 = 11/8. Full method: Step 1, 3/4 - 1/5 = 15/20 - 4/20 = 11/20. Step 2, times 5/2: 55/40. Step 3, reduce by 5: 11/8 (1.375). Takeaway: write decimals as fractions (0.2 = 1/5, 2.5 = 5/2) and reduce at the end.

items.stem: If x + y = 10 and x² − y² = 40, what is the value of x?
items.why: Fastest: x^2 - y^2 = (x + y)(x - y), so 40 = 10(x - y) and x - y = 4. Then x = (10 + 4)/2 = 7. Full method: Step 1, factor the difference of squares. Step 2, x - y = 40/10 = 4. Step 3, add the equations: 2x = 14, so x = 7 (and y = 3). Check: 49 - 9 = 40. Takeaway: x^2 - y^2 is the signal to factor into (x + y)(x - y).

items.stem: In a blend, A : B = 2 : 3 and B : C = 4 : 5. If the total amount of A, B, and C is 70 grams, how many grams of C are there?
items.why: Fastest: make B match: 2 : 3 = 8 : 12 and 4 : 5 = 12 : 15, so A : B : C = 8 : 12 : 15 (35 parts). 70 / 35 = 2 g per part; C = 15 x 2 = 30 g. Full method: B appears as 3 and 4; the least common multiple is 12. Scale A : B by 4 and B : C by 3, read off 8 : 12 : 15, then C = (15/35)(70) = 30 g. Takeaway: to chain ratios, scale the shared term to match first.

items.stem: A clinic's weekly patient count of 80 rises 20 percent, and then the new count falls 25 percent. What is the final weekly count?
items.why: Fastest: 80 x 1.2 = 96, then 96 x 0.75 = 72. Full method: Step 1, up 20 percent: 80 x 1.20 = 96. Step 2, down 25 percent of 96, which is 24: 96 - 24 = 72. Takeaway: each percent applies to the number in front of it; multiply the factors (1.2 x 0.75 = 0.9).

Fastest: 27^(2/3) = 9, 4^(1/2) = 2, 16^(1/4) = 2, so 9 x 2 / 2 = 9. Full method: Step 1, root then power: cube root of 27 is 3, squared is 9. Step 2, sqrt(4) = 2. Step 3, fourth root of 16 is 2. Step 4, (9 x 2) / 2 = 9. Takeaway: a fractional exponent m/n means the nth root raised to the m; take the root first to keep numbers small.

items.stem: A solid consists of a right circular cylinder of radius 3 and height 10 with a solid hemispherical cap of radius 3 on top. What is its total volume?
items.why: Fastest: cylinder 9 x 10 = 90 pi; hemisphere (2/3)(27) = 18 pi; total 108 pi. Full method: cylinder: pi r^2 h = pi(9)(10) = 90 pi. Hemisphere: (1/2)(4/3) pi r^3 = (2/3) pi (27) = 18 pi. Add: 108 pi. Takeaway: break a composite solid into standard pieces; a hemisphere is half of (4/3) pi r^3.
items.imgAlt: A cylinder of radius 3 and height 10 with a hemisphere of the same radius sitting on top.

items.stem: A bag contains 4 red and 6 blue marbles. Two marbles are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both are the same color?
items.why: Fastest: same color = both red OR both blue: 12/90 + 30/90 = 42/90 = 7/15. Full method: P(red, red) = (4/10)(3/9) = 12/90. P(blue, blue) = (6/10)(5/9) = 30/90. The cases cannot overlap, so add: 42/90 = 7/15. Takeaway: split 'same' into its cases, multiply within a case (AND), add across cases (OR).

items.stem: The mean of five numbers is 20. Four of the numbers are 14, 16, 22, and 30. What is the median of all five numbers?
items.why: Fastest: total 100, known 82, so the fifth is 18; sorted 14, 16, 18, 22, 30 has median 18. Full method: Step 1, sum = 5 x 20 = 100. Step 2, missing = 100 - (14 + 16 + 22 + 30) = 18. Step 3, sort: 14, 16, 18, 22, 30. Step 4, the middle (3rd) value is 18. Takeaway: use the mean to recover a missing value, then sort before you read the median.

items.stem: Working together, painters A and B can paint a room in 3 hours. Painter A working alone would take 5 hours. How long would painter B take to paint the room alone?
items.why: Fastest: B's rate = together - A = 1/3 - 1/5 = 2/15, so B alone takes 15/2 = 7.5 hours. Full method: rates add: 1/A + 1/B = 1/T. 1/5 + 1/B = 1/3, so 1/B = 5/15 - 3/15 = 2/15 and B = 7.5 hours. Takeaway: work with rates (jobs per hour), never with times; subtract a known worker's rate to find the other.

items.stem: Evaluate the expression: 5/6 ÷ 2/3 + 1/4 × 2/5 − 1/10
items.why: Fastest: 5/6 divided by 2/3 = 5/4, and 1/4 x 2/5 = 1/10, which the - 1/10 cancels. Answer 5/4. Full method: multiplication and division first: 5/6 x 3/2 = 15/12 = 5/4; 1/4 x 2/5 = 2/20 = 1/10. Then 5/4 + 1/10 - 1/10 = 5/4. Takeaway: do every multiplication and division before any addition, and watch for terms that cancel.

items.stem: Solve for all real x: √(2x + 7) = x + 2
items.why: Fastest: plug the candidates in. x = 1: sqrt(9) = 3 = 1 + 2, true. x = -3: sqrt(1) = 1 but -3 + 2 = -1, false. Only x = 1. Full method: Step 1, square both sides: 2x + 7 = x^2 + 4x + 4. Step 2, rearrange: x^2 + 2x - 3 = 0. Step 3, factor: (x + 3)(x - 1) = 0, so x = -3 or 1. Step 4, check each in the original; -3 is extraneous. Takeaway: squaring both sides can create false roots; always check in the original equation.

items.stem: A recipe uses flour and sugar in the ratio 7:4. A baker adds 3 more cups of flour than the recipe calls for and uses 2 fewer cups of sugar, changing the ratio of flour to sugar to 2:1. How many cups of sugar did the original recipe call for?
items.why: Fastest: test the sugar choices. Sugar 28 means k = 7, flour 49; then 52 : 26 = 2 : 1. It works. Full method: flour 7k, sugar 4k. After the changes, (7k + 3)/(4k - 2) = 2. Cross-multiply: 7k + 3 = 8k - 4, so k = 7. Original sugar = 4k = 28 cups. Takeaway: give each ratio part a multiplier k, apply the changes, set the new ratio, then answer for the quantity asked.

items.stem: A store marks a product up 40 percent above its cost, then during a sale takes 25 percent off the marked price. The sale price is 84 dollars. What was the store's cost, in dollars?
items.why: Fastest: net factor 1.4 x 0.75 = 1.05, so cost = 84 / 1.05 = 80. Full method: cost C. Marked price = 1.40C. Sale price = 0.75(1.40C) = 1.05C = 84. So C = 80 dollars. Check: 80 x 1.4 = 112, and 112 x 0.75 = 84. Takeaway: chain percent changes into one factor, then divide by it to work backward.

items.stem: If 2^x = 5, what is the value of 2^(3x − 1)?
items.why: Fastest: 2^(3x - 1) = (2^x)^3 / 2 = 125 / 2 = 62.5. Full method: split the exponent: 2^(3x - 1) = 2^(3x) x 2^(-1). 2^(3x) = (2^x)^3 = 5^3 = 125, and 2^(-1) = 1/2. Product: 62.5. Takeaway: break an exponent sum into a product of powers; a minus in the exponent divides.

items.stem: A right circular cylinder has its radius increased by 20% and its height decreased by 20%. By what percentage does its volume change?
items.why: Fastest: factors only: 1.2^2 x 0.8 = 1.44 x 0.8 = 1.152, a 15.2 percent increase. Full method: V = pi r^2 h. New V = pi (1.2r)^2 (0.8h) = 1.152 pi r^2 h. Change = 1.152 - 1 = 0.152 = 15.2 percent increase. Takeaway: percent changes to a formula multiply as factors, and a squared length gets its factor squared.

items.stem: A rack holds 5 blue-capped tubes and 3 red-capped tubes. Two tubes are taken at random without replacement. What is the probability that the two tubes have different cap colors?
items.why: Fastest: groups. One blue and one red: (5 x 3) / C(8,2) = 15/28. Full method: P(blue then red) = (5/8)(3/7) = 15/56 and P(red then blue) = (3/8)(5/7) = 15/56. Add the two orders: 30/56 = 15/28. Takeaway: 'different' happens in two orders; count both or count unordered groups.

items.stem: A class of 20 students has a mean score of 72. A subgroup of 8 of these students has a mean score of 78. What is the mean score of the remaining 12 students?
items.why: Fastest: totals. 20 x 72 = 1,440; 8 x 78 = 624; the other 12 sum to 816, and 816 / 12 = 68. Full method: Step 1, class total = 1,440. Step 2, subgroup total = 624. Step 3, remaining total = 816. Step 4, mean of the 12 = 68. Check: the 8 students are 6 above 72 (48 points); the 12 must be 48/12 = 4 below: 68. Takeaway: means of groups combine through totals; weight by group size.

items.stem: How many liters of a 60% acid solution must be added to 10 liters of a 25% acid solution to produce a 40% acid solution?
items.why: Fastest: seesaw. 40 is 15 from 25 and 20 from 60, so 60-percent : 25-percent = 15 : 20 = 3 : 4. With 10 L of 25 percent, add (3/4)(10) = 7.5 L. Full method: 0.60x + 0.25(10) = 0.40(x + 10). So 0.6x + 2.5 = 0.4x + 4, giving 0.2x = 1.5 and x = 7.5 L. Takeaway: match the pure acid on both sides, and the larger share always sits closer to the target strength.

items.stem: Let a = 0.363636... (the block 36 repeating) and b = 0.454545... (the block 45 repeating). What is the value of (a + 1/6) divided by b, in lowest terms?
items.why: Fastest: repeating blocks over 99: a = 36/99 = 4/11 and b = 45/99 = 5/11. Then 4/11 + 1/6 = 24/66 + 11/66 = 35/66, and 35/66 x 11/5 = 7/6. Full method: Step 1, convert: a = 4/11, b = 5/11. Step 2, add over 66: 35/66. Step 3, divide by 5/11 by multiplying by 11/5: 385/330 = 7/6. Takeaway: a two-digit repeating block is the block over 99; then it is ordinary fraction arithmetic.

items.stem: Real numbers x and y satisfy x + y = 5 and xy = 6. What is the value of x^2 + y^2?
items.why: Fastest: x^2 + y^2 = (x + y)^2 - 2xy = 25 - 12 = 13. (Check with the actual numbers: x and y are 2 and 3, and 4 + 9 = 13.) Full method: Step 1, square the sum: (x + y)^2 = x^2 + 2xy + y^2 = 25. Step 2, substitute xy = 6: x^2 + y^2 + 12 = 25. Step 3, x^2 + y^2 = 13. Takeaway: (a + b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2; never drop the middle term.

items.stem: In a collection of items, the ratio A : B = 3 : 4 and the ratio B : C = 6 : 7. If A + B + C = 210, how many items are in group C?
items.why: Fastest: make B match at 12: A : B = 9 : 12 and B : C = 12 : 14, so A : B : C = 9 : 12 : 14 (35 parts). 210 / 35 = 6, and C = 14 x 6 = 84. Full method: least common multiple of 4 and 6 is 12. Scale 3 : 4 by 3 and 6 : 7 by 2. Then C = (14/35)(210) = 84. Check: 54 + 72 + 84 = 210. Takeaway: before chaining two ratios, scale the shared term to the same number.

items.stem: Over four years, a lake's fish population changes by +20 percent, then -15 percent, then +25 percent, then -10 percent, each change applied to the previous year's population. Compared with the starting population, the population after the four years is:
items.why: Fastest: pretend it starts at 100. 120, then 120 x 0.85 = 102, then 102 x 1.25 = 127.5, then 127.5 x 0.9 = 114.75: up 14.75 percent. Full method: overall factor = 1.20 x 0.85 x 1.25 x 0.90 = 1.1475, a 14.75 percent increase. Takeaway: chain growth factors; adding percents only works for a single change.

items.stem: Suppose 2^x = 3 and 2^y = 5. What is the value of 2^(3x - 2y)?
items.why: Fastest: 2^(3x - 2y) = (2^x)^3 / (2^y)^2 = 27/25. Full method: Step 1, split the exponent: 2^(3x) / 2^(2y). Step 2, 2^(3x) = (2^x)^3 = 3^3 = 27 and 2^(2y) = (2^y)^2 = 5^2 = 25. Step 3, 27/25. Takeaway: exponent rules let you use 2^x as a block without ever solving for x.

items.stem: A sphere is inscribed in a right circular cylinder so that it touches the cylinder's curved surface and both circular bases. The cylinder's volume is 54π. What is the volume of the sphere?
items.why: Fastest: a sphere snug in a cylinder is 2/3 of it: (2/3)(54 pi) = 36 pi. Full method: the cylinder's radius is r and its height is 2r, so its volume is 2 pi r^3 = 54 pi and r^3 = 27 (r = 3). Sphere = (4/3) pi r^3 = 36 pi. Takeaway: inscribed means touching: the sphere's diameter equals the cylinder's height and width.
items.imgAlt: A sphere inside a cylinder, touching the curved side and both circular ends.

items.stem: A bag contains 5 red marbles and 4 blue marbles. Three marbles are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that exactly two of the three drawn are red?
items.why: Fastest: combinations. C(5,2) x C(4,1) = 10 x 4 = 40 of C(9,3) = 84, so 40/84 = 10/21. Full method: total groups of 3 from 9: 84. Favorable: choose 2 of the 5 red (10 ways) and 1 of the 4 blue (4 ways): 40. Probability 40/84 = 10/21. (By order: 3 x (5/9)(4/8)(4/7) = 10/21.) Takeaway: for 'exactly k of a kind', multiply the combinations for each kind and divide by the total combinations.

items.stem: A set of five distinct positive integers has a mean of 10 and a median of 12. What is the greatest possible value of the largest element in the set?
items.why: Fastest: make everything else as small as the rules allow: 1, 2, 12, 13. The largest is 50 - 28 = 22. Full method: Step 1, the sum is 5 x 10 = 50 and the middle value is 12. Step 2, to maximize the largest, minimize the others: the two below 12 are 1 and 2; the one above 12 is at least 13. Step 3, largest = 50 - (1 + 2 + 12 + 13) = 22. Takeaway: to maximize one value under a fixed sum, push every other value to its smallest legal value.

items.stem: A 20-liter tank is filled with pure acid. First, 4 liters are drained and replaced with water and the tank is stirred. Then 4 liters of the resulting mixture are drained and again replaced with water. How many liters of pure acid remain in the tank?
items.why: Fastest: each step keeps 16/20 = 0.8 of the acid: 20 x 0.8 x 0.8 = 12.8 liters. Full method: Step 1, drain 4 L of pure acid: 16 L acid remain; refill to 20 L. Step 2, the mix is 80 percent acid, so draining 4 L removes 3.2 L acid: 16 - 3.2 = 12.8 L. Takeaway: repeated drain-and-replace multiplies by the fraction kept each time.

items.stem: Let x = 0.272727... (the two-digit block '27' repeating forever) and y = 0.16666... (only the digit '6' repeating). What is the exact value of x - y?
items.why: Fastest: x = 27/99 = 3/11 and y = 1/6 (from 1/6 = 0.1666...). 3/11 - 1/6 = 18/66 - 11/66 = 7/66. Full method: Step 1, a two-digit repeating block is the block over 99: 27/99 = 3/11. Step 2, 0.1666... = 0.1 + 0.0666... = 1/10 + 1/15 = 1/6. Step 3, subtract over 66: 7/66. Takeaway: know 1/6 = 0.1666... and 1/3 = 0.333...; turn repeating blocks into fractions before doing anything else.

items.stem: A real number x satisfies x + 1/x = 3. What is the value of x^4 + 1/x^4?
items.why: Fastest: square, subtract 2, twice. 3^2 - 2 = 7; 7^2 - 2 = 47. Full method: Step 1, (x + 1/x)^2 = x^2 + 2 + 1/x^2 = 9, so x^2 + 1/x^2 = 7. Step 2, (x^2 + 1/x^2)^2 = x^4 + 2 + 1/x^4 = 49, so x^4 + 1/x^4 = 47. Takeaway: x times 1/x is 1, so every square of a sum like this has a cross term of exactly 2.

items.stem: The quantity y varies directly with x and inversely with the square of z. When x = 6 and z = 2, y = 3. What is y when x = 15 and z = 5?
items.why: Fastest: ratio method. y scales by (15/6) for x and by (2/5)^2 for z: 3 x 2.5 x 4/25 = 1.2. Full method: y = kx/z^2. From 3 = k(6)/4, k = 2. Then y = 2(15)/25 = 30/25 = 1.2. Takeaway: write the variation as one equation, find k once, then reuse it.

items.stem: A lake's fish population rises 25 percent, then falls 20 percent, then falls 10 percent, in that order. What is the overall change in the population?
items.why: Fastest: 1.25 x 0.8 = 1 exactly, so only the last 10 percent drop is left: 10 percent decrease. Full method: overall factor = 1.25 x 0.80 x 0.90 = 0.90, which is 90 percent of the start, a 10 percent decrease. Takeaway: look for factors that cancel to 1 (1.25 and 0.8), then multiply what is left.

Fastest: everything is a power of 2: 2^2 + 2^(-3) + 2^2 = 4 + 1/8 + 4 = 65/8. Full method: 8^(2/3) = (2^3)^(2/3) = 4. 16^(-3/4) = (2^4)^(-3/4) = 2^(-3) = 1/8. (1/32)^(-2/5) = (2^(-5))^(-2/5) = 2^2 = 4. Sum = 65/8. Takeaway: rewrite every base as a power of the same prime, then multiply the exponents.

items.stem: A sphere is inscribed in a cube whose edge length is 6. A second, smaller cube is then inscribed inside that sphere. What is the volume of the smaller cube?
items.why: Fastest: the sphere's diameter (6) is the inner cube's space diagonal, s sqrt(3) = 6, so s = 2 sqrt(3) and s^3 = 8 x 3 sqrt(3) = 24 sqrt(3). Full method: Step 1, sphere inscribed in the outer cube: diameter = edge = 6. Step 2, inner cube inscribed in the sphere: its space diagonal s sqrt(3) = 6, so s = 6/sqrt(3) = 2 sqrt(3). Step 3, V = (2 sqrt(3))^3 = 24 sqrt(3), about 41.6. Takeaway: a cube's space diagonal is s sqrt(3), its face diagonal s sqrt(2).

items.stem: A committee of 3 people is chosen at random from a group of 5 men and 4 women. What is the probability that the committee includes at least one man and at least one woman?
items.why: Fastest: 1 minus what you do not want. All men C(5,3) = 10, all women C(4,3) = 4, total C(9,3) = 84: 1 - 14/84 = 70/84 = 5/6. Full method: mixed committees = 2 men 1 woman (10 x 4 = 40) + 1 man 2 women (5 x 6 = 30) = 70, out of 84. 70/84 = 5/6. Takeaway: 'at least one of each' is easiest as total minus the one-group cases.

items.stem: Five positive integers have a mean of 12, a median of 12, and a unique mode of 8. What is the greatest possible value of the largest of the five integers?
items.why: Fastest: 8, 8, 12, then the smallest legal fourth value, 13; the largest is 60 - 41 = 19. Full method: sum = 5 x 12 = 60; sorted middle = 12; a unique mode of 8 needs two 8s below the median. The fourth value cannot be 12 (that would tie the mode), so it is at least 13. Largest = 60 - (8 + 8 + 12 + 13) = 19. Takeaway: list the constraints, then push every other value to its smallest legal value.

items.stem: An empty tank is filled by pipe A (which alone fills it in 6 hours) and pipe B (which alone fills it in 4 hours), both open from the start. A drain C (which alone empties a full tank in 3 hours) is opened the instant the tank becomes half full and then stays open. What is the total time to fill the tank completely?
items.why: Fastest: two stages. Half a tank at 5/12 per hour takes 1.2 hours; half a tank at 5/12 - 4/12 = 1/12 per hour takes 6 hours. Total 7.2 hours. Full method: Stage 1, A + B = 1/6 + 1/4 = 5/12 tank per hour; (1/2)/(5/12) = 1.2 hours. Stage 2, subtract the drain: 5/12 - 1/3 = 1/12; (1/2)/(1/12) = 6 hours. Sum: 7.2 hours. Takeaway: when the setup changes partway, split the job into stages and use the right net rate for each.
